The '''Pugs''' were a gang of [[Canine/Legends|canine]]-like bandits who lived on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. They rode around on creatures called [[vroom]]s.<ref name="PE">{{Ewoks|Party Ewok}}</ref>
